title: Measured weekly-projection dispersion for Game Day draws
current_system: Truncated Gaussian with fallback CVs QB .32 RB .55 WR .60 TE .65 IDP .45-.55
evidence: RPA-F-021 (RESEARCH_PROMOTION_READINESS_AUDIT_2026-10-25) confirms fallback in production; V3 measured rosValue-error CVs 0.73-1.20 (evaluation_v3.json fits.week5-8); served F pooled PIT 80/95 coverage 0.44/0.62 (SIM_CALIBRATION_V3_RESULTS). Weekly-provider residual CV itself unmeasured.
evidence_class: DEMONSTRATED-IN-REPO (gap); PLAUSIBLE HYPOTHESIS (magnitude for weekly means)
proposed: Position CVs (optional player shrinkage) on a log-residual scale, fitted expanding-window from pregame-archive residuals
mechanism: Empirical residual dispersion replaces constants; refit weekly on point-in-time data only
data_available: Pregame projection archive from week 8; Sleeper finals; host scorer
data_missing: Weeks 1-7 2026 pregame projections; no genuine 2025 pre-kickoff archive
consumers: Game Day win/median %, playoff sim, trade impact
risk: Wider intervals look less decisive; weekly-mean variance differs from ROS-based V3 values
evaluation: PoC-1: player-cluster bootstrap CRPS and PIT coverage weeks 10-14; AL-4a Brier report-only
acceptance: dCRPS(F-M) 98.33% CI lower>0; pooled 80% coverage in [0.75,0.85]; no position outside [0.70,0.90]
rejection: dCRPS CI upper<0, or coverage gained only via >=1.5x interval width
novelty_note: Standard practice; novelty low, value high

title: Increment-consistent remainder variance for in-progress players
current_system: Remaining mean = pregame baseline x remaining_fraction; same CV applied, so SD proportional to f
current_method: SD shrinks linearly with remaining fraction
evidence: Code inspection; arithmetic: at f=0.25 current SD is 0.50x an increments (sqrt f) model, 0.32x at f=0.10 (scratchpad/proj/diag.py). Toy win prob 0.966 vs 0.856 is illustration only.
proposed: SD proportional to f^gamma with gamma=0.5 fixed a priori (compound-Poisson increments)
mechanism: Variance of a sum of roughly independent in-game increments scales with time remaining
data_available: AL-4a live progress buckets in generations.jsonl
data_missing: Per-player in-game banked/remaining snapshots may not be archived
consumers: Live Game Day probabilities, median race, leverage
risk: Overcorrection if scoring is front-loaded; banked-points guard must be kept byte-for-byte
evaluation: AL-4a late-live bucket reliability and Brier by model version; player-level remainder coverage if snapshots exist
acceptance: Late-bucket reliability slope closer to 1 and Brier not worse over >=4 weeks
rejection: Late-bucket Brier worse, or no measurable change across >=4 weeks
effort: 1 day code plus weeks of outcomes
novelty_note: Not found in repo; external novelty uncertain

title: Game-level correlated shocks in Game Day draws
evidence: V3-D4: tau^2 same-roster same-NFL-team 0.0169 vs roster-wide 0.0088 over 2,646 pairs (evaluation_v3.json)
proposed: One multiplicative N(0,tau_game^2) factor per NFL team-game plus an opponent-game factor; tau from residual pair covariance
mechanism: Variance-components latent factor rather than copula
data_available: Residual pairs from the archive; schedule
data_missing: Team-game identities for historical weeks when players changed teams
consumers: Win %, median %, leverage, P(in final lineup)
risk: Stacks shift win% for concentrated rosters; small tau estimates are noisy
evaluation: Team-week CRPS and coverage on re-simulated archived weeks; held-out residual covariance
acceptance: Team-week 80% coverage closer to nominal with CRPS not worse
rejection: tau CI includes 0 on held-out weeks, or team CRPS worse
novelty_note: Common in DFS research; paused DFS correlation code is study-only

title: Calibration receipts on displayed probabilities
current_system: AL-4a scorecard merged but unscheduled; no calibration badge found on Game Day outputs by grep
evidence: RPA-LGI-004 / RPA-F-029: scorecards merged, nothing schedules them; V3 C3 designs a calibrationState descriptor
proposed: Weekly AL-4a run; one descriptor calibrationState unverified|failing|tracking with n, Brier, reliability slope, read by every probability surface
mechanism: Proper scoring rules + reliability; display wording gated on evidence
data_missing: Enough events for stable reliability (about 6-12 per league-week)
consumers: Game Day UI, public playoff odds, Power
risk: Low-n badges must never read as significance
evaluation: Weekly report with the AL-0 small-sample flag
acceptance: Every probability surface shows the owner descriptor state
rejection: Surfaces infer state instead of reading the owner
novelty_note: Reliability pages exist in forecasting media; rare in fantasy apps (uncertain)

title: Weekly automated learning report (AL-3b scheduled + distributional metrics)
current_system: Projection scorecard merged and unscheduled; point error only
proposed: Weekly private report: PIT, 50/80/90 coverage, CRPS by position x provider x projected/unprojected; Game Day reliability; frozen-study status read-only; biggest misses with reasons
risk: Report fatigue; must never refit frozen studies
evaluation: Report generated every finalized week with receipts

title: ROS aggregate: rank censoring instead of missing-at-random skip
current_system: Sources that did not rank a player are skipped; weighted mean of present sources
current_method: Weighted mean of available rank scores
evidence: Code skips absent rows; NC-A: D=0.870 [0.797,0.952], IDP slope 0.52, DraftSharks basis step, total_ranked dependence (ROS_SCALE_CALIBRATION_RESULTS_2026-10-28)
proposed: Shadow field: absence from a depth-N list treated as rank>N with tail-expected score and a pattern-mixture sensitivity band
data_available: Snapshot history under data/ros; source depths
consumers: Team strength, tags, playoff presim (shadow only)
risk: rosValue change is owner-reserved; shadow only; must not touch H1 frozen fits
evaluation: Prospective ROS-horizon ordering under a new prereg separate from H1
acceptance: Shadow ordering concordance CI lower>0 vs current
rejection: No ordering gain, or instability across snapshots
novelty_note: Censored-rank aggregation known in rank-aggregation literature; not in repo

title: Evaluate / simplify hardcoded ROS format and freshness multipliers
evidence: No empirical support found in repo
proposed: Leave-one-source-out and equal-weight comparison under a separate prereg
acceptance: Equal weights not worse -> recommend SIMPLIFY
rejection: Multipliers show a significant gain -> KEEP

title: Empirical-Bayes credibility for BDVM n_prior
evidence: params_v1 describes priors, not validated truth; no estimation found
proposed: Buhlmann n0 = E[within-player weekly variance] / Var(true per-game means) per position from multi-season nflverse scored by the host card, including prior-mean error
data_missing: Historical projection vintages for the prior-mean error term
risk: Ignoring prior-mean error would overweight the prior
evaluation: Walk-forward ROS per-game MAE by position 2023-2025
acceptance: Estimated n0 better with CI lower>0 in >=2 positions, none worse
rejection: No improvement, or n0 unstable across seasons
novelty_note: Standard actuarial method; new to repo

title: Role Change Radar (offense; shared surface with IDP S2)
current_system: No usage change-point detection for offense; IDP ROLE feature only in research
evidence: #2053 S2 for IDP; earlier injury-replacement proxy failed
proposed: BOCPD with Normal-Inverse-Gamma segments on logit usage share; calibrated change probability with abstention
consumers: Player profile, waivers, Game Day context
acceptance: Beats EWMA in flagged subset (CI lower>0) and flag precision>=0.5
rejection: No gain over EWMA, or precision<0.35
novelty_note: Snap-trend views are common; calibrated change probability less so (uncertain)

title: Projection Blind-Spot Map (provider non-coverage as a selection process)
current_system: Unprojected players are excluded from streaming candidates
current_method: Missing projection -> invisible to optimizer (correctly never zero)
evidence: Provider projects only 56-62% of scoring defender-weeks (IDP_STREAMING_GAP_DECOMPOSITION_2026-11-01 section 1)
proposed: Two-stage P(projected) and production|played with missingness indicators; surface P(score>=cut) for unprojected free agents with a delta-shift sensitivity band, labelled model estimate
data_available: Sleeper stats, snap counts, provider rows in the archive
risk: Must never be presented as a provider projection; frozen IDP study untouched
evaluation: Recall of free-agent defenders beating the 9th-best rostered starter, prospective weeks 10-14
acceptance: Recall gain with precision not below provider-projected free agents
rejection: No recall gain, or sensitivity band spans the decision
novelty_note: Not found in repo; external novelty uncertain (original in this repo)

title: Exceedance Board: rank streaming adds by P(X > marginal starter)
current_system: Optimizer ranks by point projection; shrinkage compresses the top of the cut
evidence: CB top-N hit 0.08 (M2) vs 0.22 (C0) (IDP_OPPORTUNITY_CHALLENGERS_RESULTS); hindsight bound +52.7 vs +0.4 (gap decomposition)
proposed: Calibrated predictive distributions -> P(X_FA > X_marginal_starter) and expected lineup gain via scenario draws through the exact solver
mechanism: Decision-aware objective; scenario Monte Carlo (not DRO)
risk: Depends on calibration; default zero dynasty-loss budget must hold
evaluation: Streaming decision replay on prospective weeks vs mean ranking
acceptance: Positive decision-week gain with CI lower>0 over >=6 weeks
rejection: No gain, or worse downside tail
novelty_note: Tail-probability ranking known in DFS; new for dynasty streaming here

title: Live usage nowcast (in-game Bayesian rate update)
current_system: Remaining = baseline x clock fraction; no in-game usage
evidence: Code inspection; live provider access under evaluation (BALLDONTLIE_LIVE_STATE_EVALUATION)
proposed: Gamma-Poisson events-per-play update with the pregame projection as prior; play count from live state
data_missing: Per-player in-game snaps/targets/tackles under current access
acceptance: Live Brier better in mid-game buckets
novelty_note: Live win-probability models exist in sports media; player-level fantasy less common

acceptance: Log score and CRPS better, no position worse
rejection: No gain over the log-residual model M
